tagline.en_US: Run JupyterLab from the official Jupyter Docker Stacks image. The image includes Python and the Jupyter server; notebook files persist in the work directory. ProxMenux generates an access token during installation and shows it when setup finishes.

description.en_US: JupyterLab is a web-based user interface for interactive computing and data science. It enables users to create and execute code, work with notebooks, and manage computational workflows. The environment provides a flexible workspace for working with data, visualization tools, and scientific libraries.
